text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 303, March 16, 1971 ]
FURTHER AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 11, SERIES OF 1966, AS AMENDED BY
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 220 DATED MARCH 21, 1970, CREATING THE ANTI-SMUGGLING
ACTION CENTER
Executive Order No. 11, series of 1966, creating the Anti-Smuggling Action Center, as amended by Executive
Order No. 220 dated March 21, 1970, is hereby further amended by placing the Center under the direct
supervision and control of the Secretary of Finance.
All orders, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby modified or repealed accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
